title: Layout of the silent-simulation tapes
statement: For a natural number $m$ and any tape index $j\in\{0,\ldots,m+1\}$, $j$ lies in the image of the standard embedding of the first $m+1$ tape indices into these $m+2$ indices if and only if $j<m+1$. It lies outside that image if and only if $j$ is the final index $m+1$.
